summary: Uncommitted rewrite from boolean to a result type with per-rule reasons; tests check validity only, far from the length limits.

defects.description: The length tests use 1 and 30 characters, far from the 3 and 20 limits, so `name.length < 3` -> `<= 3` and `> 20` -> `>= 20` survive. Tests need names of exactly 2, 3, 20 and 21 characters.

The rejection tests assert only `valid === false`, and `reports why a name is rejected` uses `toHaveProperty("reason")`, which passes for any reason. The reason codes are user-facing, yet mutating any reason string (or reordering the checks so a different rule fires) survives. Each rejection should assert toEqual({ valid: false, reason: ... }).
